title: Darth Vader's Iconic Star Wars Lightsaber Sells for Nearly $5 Million at Auction
meta_title: Darth Vader Lightsaber Sells for Record $4.875M at Auction
meta_description: A lightsaber used by Darth Vader in Star Wars has shattered records, selling for $4.875 million at a Heritage Auctions event.
discover_titles: Darth Vader Lightsaber Fetches Record $4.875 Million at Auction
Star Wars Prop Sells for Nearly $5 Million, Breaking Records
Famous Darth Vader Weapon Sets New World Record for Collectible
spot: A lightsaber used by Darth Vader in 'The Empire Strikes Back' and 'Return of the Jedi' has sold for $4.875 million at a Heritage Auctions event, setting a new world record for any Star Wars collectible and screen-used prop.
content_html:
Key Developments

A historic piece of cinema history has found a new home after fetching $4.875 million during the Ultimate Star Wars Auction held by Heritage Auctions. The weapon was wielded by Darth Vader during the iconic and climactic duel in Cloud City featured in The Empire Strikes Back, the unforgettable scene where the villain reveals to Luke Skywalker that he is his father. The prop was also utilized in Return of the Jedi.

The blockbuster sale successfully shattered previous auction benchmarks. According to the auction organizer, the final price established a new world record for any Star Wars collectible ever sold. Furthermore, it set a brand-new auction record for a screen-used Star Wars prop, comfortably surpassing Heritage's previous July auction sale of Luke Skywalker's lightsaber and severed hand-effects rig, which brought in $3.75 million.

The high-profile Thursday auction featured an extensive lineup of rare materials and production items spanning Star Wars Episodes I through IX, alongside props from various other notable films and television shows. Alongside the headline-making Vader weapon, a total of 27 other authentic Star Wars lightsabers were assembled for public acquisition during the major event.

Key Takeaways

  • Record-Breaking Sale: Darth Vader's lightsaber sold for $4.875 million, setting a new world record for a Star Wars collectible.
  • Historic Screen Prop: The weapon was famously used in the Cloud City duel from The Empire Strikes Back.
  • Surpassing Previous Highs: The sale easily beat the $3.75 million July auction record set by Luke Skywalker's lightsaber and effects rig.

Why It Matters

The monumental sale underscores the enduring, multi-generational cultural impact and commercial value of the Star Wars franchise. Screen-used props from the original trilogy continue to command unprecedented figures on the global collector market, reflecting the profound nostalgia and high demand attached to tangible pieces of cinematic history. By overtaking previous records set just months prior, the auction demonstrates that top-tier memorabilia from the legendary space opera remains one of the most lucrative and fiercely contested categories in modern entertainment collecting.
